measurement: TOPLOC per-span audit bands of Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B under flash_attention_2 vs sdpa

data.smoke: /opt/smoke.json (Task 14 smoke: 8 real SWE-smith episodes, 12 turns each, 7,953-14,144 tokens, proofs from the miner's span builder, vLLM 0.30, prefix cache on); production path span_hidden_states + trajectory_chunk_scores + trajectory_outcome
data.m1: /opt/m1-27b.json + /opt/m1-27b-off.json (gate M1: 64 synthetic trajectories x 6 turns, cache on/off, proofs from build_chunk_proofs); gate path verify_chunk_proofs per span + sequence_verdict; 'judged_spans' = spans >= 8 tokens, the ones production judges

configs.vllm-venv-sdpa: the stack M1 and the e2e measured with: /opt/vllm/venv, torch 2.13 cu130, transformers 5.18.0, no flash_attn, no fla, no causal_conv1d (GatedDeltaNet on the torch reference path)
configs.prod-stack-sdpa: fresh /opt/fa2-venv with the validator image's stack (root Dockerfile): python 3.12, torch 2.7.0+cu128, flash_attn 2.8.3, flash-linear-attention 0.5.0, causal_conv1d 1.5.2, transformers 5.10.4 (pyproject pin); attention sdpa
configs.prod-stack-fa2: same venv, attention flash_attention_2 = what production runs (GRAIL_ATTN_IMPL default)

cross_check: prod-stack-fa2 'miner_vllm_proofs' = proofs made by the miner's vLLM verified by the validator under FA2; 'cross_validator_proofs' = proofs built from the validator's own sdpa activations (prod stack) verified under FA2
notes: All 8 smoke and 64 M1 trajectories pass under every config; no judged chunk exceeds any threshold.
The only chunks over a threshold anywhere are the 1-token span m1-27b*.json:18 (exp 64 under prod-stack sdpa; 60 under FA2 and vLLM-venv sdpa); production does not judge spans under 8 tokens.
Coverage: real trajectories up to 14,144 tokens only; 40-60k contexts not measured under FA2.
